title: Realty Income Raises Monthly Dividend to $0.2740 per Share
summary: Realty Income raised its monthly dividend to $0.2740 per share from $0.2715, payable December 15, 2026, to stockholders of record on November 30, 2026.
body_markdown:
Gotrade News - Realty Income ([O](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/o/) ) declared an increase in its monthly dividend to $0.2740 per share from $0.2715 on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, according to[Realty Income's official release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/137th-common-stock-monthly-dividend-increase-declared-by-realty-income-302935556.html) . The dividend is payable on Tuesday, December 15, 2026, to stockholders of record as of Monday, November 30, 2026.

## What Realty Income Announced


Realty Income declared an increase in its common stock monthly cash dividend to $0.2740 per share from $0.2715 per share, the company said in its release published at 4:05 p.m. ET. The dividend is payable on Tuesday, December 15, 2026, to stockholders of record as of Monday, November 30, 2026.
